<thought>To determine the number of carbonyl groups, I will obtain the 13C NMR spectrum of the sample and compare the observed carbon chemical shifts to the typical carbonyl carbon range (≈190‑220 ppm). By counting how many peaks fall within this range, I can infer the number of carbonyl carbons, which corresponds to the number of carbonyl groups.</thought>
